Class GameController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.controller.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameObserver
public class GameController extends Object implements GameObserver
Per-game server-side controller that bridges the network layer and the domain model for a single game session.

Responsibilities:

  • Receives granular commands from ControllerManager and forwards them to the ModelInterface.
  • Implements GameObserver to receive model notifications and fan them out to all connected clients via VirtualView.
  • Maintains a global event history for reconnecting players (catch-up replay).
  • Manages per-player and global disconnection timers; invokes AutoPlayer when a timer expires.
  • Logs every successfully applied command to a GameLogger for crash-recovery replay.

All public methods are synchronized on the controller's monitor. Background tasks (drain threads, timer callbacks, AutoPlayer) acquire the same lock before reading or writing shared state.

    • setGameEndedCallback

      public void setGameEndedCallback(Runnable callback)
      Registers a callback invoked once after the game ends (normal finish or forfeit). The callback runs on a daemon thread to avoid blocking the monitor.
      Parameters:
      callback - the runnable to call when the game session is fully over

    • executeMoveTotem

      public void executeMoveTotem(String nickname, char tileId)
      Logs and executes a move-totem action on behalf of the given player. Logging is skipped during replay mode, since commands are already persisted in the NDJSON file being replayed.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player performing the action
      tileId - the letter identifier of the target offer tile

    • executeResolveActions

      public void executeResolveActions(String nickname, List<String> selectedIds)

      selectedIds - the card identifiers the player wishes to take

    • handlePlayerDisconnected

      public void handlePlayerDisconnected(String nickname)
      Called by the network layer when a player's connection is lost. Updates connection status, notifies other players, and arms the appropriate timer (per-player or global).
      Parameters:
      nickname - the disconnected player's nickname

    • handlePlayerReconnected

      public void handlePlayerReconnected(String nickname, VirtualView newView)
      Called by ControllerManager when a player reconnects. Immediately begins streaming the global event history to the new view on a background thread, then transitions the player to CONNECTED once the drain is complete.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the reconnecting player's nickname
      newView - the new VirtualView for this connection
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the server is still in replay mode and cannot yet accept reconnections

    • areAllPlayersPendingReconnection

      public boolean areAllPlayersPendingReconnection()
      Returns:
      true if every player is in ConnectionStatus.PENDING_RECONNECTION state, meaning the game was recovered from a log but no one has reconnected yet

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()
      Cancels all timers and shuts down the background executor services. Safe to call more than once.
